description: The Insert Image dialog: one URL field plus a Cancel / Apply footer. It used to be inline markup inside TmSpreadsheet; it now rides the core TmModal frame, which owns the overlay, the dialog role, the initial focus on the URL field, the document-level Escape, the focus restore (to the grid) and the mobile sheet. The URL is validated with Uri.TryCreate and only an absolute http(s) address or a data: URI can be applied — Apply stays disabled and the field carries aria-invalid plus an inline alert until then. Enter applies from the field; applying raises the URL, which the spreadsheet writes to the active cell's ImageUrl (the canvas paints it).

parameters.name: ImageUrl
parameters.description: The URL the field starts with (an existing cell image, when the host edits one).

parameters.name: OnApply
parameters.description: Raised with the accepted image URL.

parameters.name: OnCancel
parameters.description: Raised when the dialog is dismissed (Cancel, Escape or a backdrop click).

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTargetId
parameters.description: The id of the element focus returns to on close — the host spreadsheet passes its grid root so focus lands on the grid. Null falls back to the element focused before the dialog opened.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the dialog renders. Auto follows the viewport scope (a sheet on the narrow one); a forced value pins the mode without measuring, so a test can render the mobile sheet without a DOM.
